correctness.rationale: For a six-element periodic P1 heat FEM mesh with alternating edges a,b, consistent mass M has offdiagonal h/6, stiffness K offdiagonal -1/h. For tau>0, independent exact 3-mode cyclic Fourier reduction of 6x6 D=M+tau K verifies P_{0,2}=2tau(6tau-a²)(ab+b²+6tau)/H and P_{0,4}=2tau(6tau-b²)(a²+ab+6tau)/H, H=(ab+6tau)(ab+12tau)(a²+3ab+b²+6tau)>0. Hence positivity forces tau>=max(a²,b²)/6. Conversely at or above threshold offdiagonals D<=0, strict row diagonal dominance by D1=M1>0, so D inverse nonnegative M matrix and P=D^-1M>=0; tau=0 gives identity. Six independent exact rational 6x6 inversions and fully symbolic mode decomposition confirm both entries. The proof covers every a,b>0 including equal case and endpoint equality.
